## Terms

### DATE Criteria

- **DATE Criteria** · self — DATE criteria supports five date format types: ISODATE (ISO-8601 formatted date, default), EPOCH_SECONDS, EPOCH_MILLIS, EPOCH_NANOSECONDS (all Unix epoch timestamps requiring BSON type long), and OBJECT_ID. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/online-archive/configure-online-archive-standard/
